defect_record.prior_amendment_gap: Amendment 002 froze the per-workstream primary decision axis but did not freeze a mutually exclusive projection from the accepted multi-axis case state into the four frozen workstream case buckets, so the same case could be pulled into more than one bucket of one workstream

unresolved_bucket_cases.state: PRIMARY_STATUS = NOT_ESTABLISHED with PRIMARY_CONFIDENCE = HISTORICAL_ONLY and a historical workstream family present
unresolved_bucket_cases.defect: under the frozen bucket names this case matches both STALE_OR_HISTORICAL_CASES and NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES; no rule forbids the double membership
unresolved_bucket_cases.resolution_in_this_amendment: HISTORICAL_OR_STALE_CASES with reason code HISTORICAL_ONLY_FAMILY; it must not also be placed in NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES when it qualifies for the historical bucket

unresolved_bucket_cases.defect: an explicit current negative observation has no bucket under the four frozen bucket names and would be forced into CURRENT / STALE / RESOLVED / NOT_ESTABLISHED, each of which states something different
unresolved_bucket_cases.resolution_in_this_amendment: new bucket CURRENT_NEGATIVE_CASES with reason code CURRENT_NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE; it must not be counted as NOT_ESTABLISHED, RESOLVED_OR_CLOSED or CURRENT_CONFIRMED

defect_record.why_bucket_name_is_insufficient: HISTORICAL_OR_STALE_CASES must never be read as ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = HISTORICAL_STALE: historical-only evidence and mechanically stale attribution are different facts that share one bucket

supersedes_prospectively: workstream_matrix_schema case-bucket vocabulary and case-bucket semantics: the effective set becomes the five buckets frozen in workstream_bucket_projection
Amendment 002 case_bucket_derivation_rules where a bucket condition conflicts with this amendment (see superseded_amendment_002_bucket_rules)
the implicit assumption that the four old bucket names alone partition the global case inventory

Amendment 002 CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES and RESOLVED_CASES conditions are retained verbatim

Amendment 001 multi-axis case state schema and values
amendment_scope.existing_r2_harness_and_tests: UNCHANGED / NOT AUTHORIZED TO MODIFY IN THIS CHECKPOINT

r2_accepted_case_state_reference.r2_state_prerequisite_for_r3: R3 must project workstream case buckets from the accepted multi-axis case state under the projection frozen by this amendment; this amendment adds no new case-state field and changes no case-state value

workstream_bucket_projection.PRIMARY_AXIS_SOURCE: Amendment 002 workstream_axis_mapping (PRIMARY_DECISION_AXIS / PRIMARY_STATUS_FIELD / PRIMARY_ROOT_CAUSE_FILTER); retained verbatim
workstream_bucket_projection.CASE_STATE_SOURCE: Amendment 001 amended multi-axis case state (PRODUCT_STATUS, PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES, PRODUCT_MULTI_CAUSE, PRODUCT_CONFIDENCE, MEASUREMENT_STATUS, MEASUREMENT_CONFIDENCE, CITATION_STATUS, CITATION_CONFIDENCE, BLOCKED_OR_DISPROVEN_PATHS, ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS, RELEVANT_LATER_CHANGE, RELEVANT_LATER_CHANGE_EVIDENCE, LATEST_PRODUCT_STATE_COMPATIBLE, LATEST_SOURCES); unchanged by this amendment

RESOLVED_CASES (field retained; rule clarified by this amendment)
NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES (field retained; explicit current-negative observations removed from this bucket)

DOMAIN_ELIGIBILITY_BEFORE_PROJECTION.order: domain eligibility is applied first; only cases eligible for the workstream are projected into its five buckets

PRODUCT_workstreams.eligible_when: the workstream PRIMARY_ROOT_CAUSE_FILTER family is present in the case PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES (Amendment 002 family_relevance_definition retained)
PRODUCT_workstreams.historical_family_alone_effect: establishes historical relevance for this workstream only; it can never establish a current defect
PRODUCT_workstreams.not_eligible_effect: a case not carrying the workstream family is outside that workstream's review domain and is counted in none of its five buckets

MEASUREMENT_workstream.eligible_when: the case carries a MEASUREMENT_STATUS record inside the accepted multi-axis case state (Amendment 001 record_required_fields); no Product root-cause filter applies
MEASUREMENT_workstream.note: a case whose measurement record is NOT_ESTABLISHED stays inside the domain and projects to NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES; it is not dropped

CITATION_workstream.eligible_when: the case carries a CITATION_STATUS record inside the accepted multi-axis case state; no Product root-cause filter applies
CITATION_workstream.note: same as MEASUREMENT: NOT_ESTABLISHED stays in-domain and projects to NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES

DOMAIN_ELIGIBILITY_BEFORE_PROJECTION.eligibility_is_not_projection: the eligibility filter never assigns a bucket by itself; the axis projection rules below do

BUCKET_PRECEDENCE.purpose: prevent accidental double membership when multiple projection signals coexist for one eligible case
BUCKET_PRECEDENCE.mechanical_interpretation: evaluate the bucket conditions in order 1 to 5 and assign the case to the first bucket whose condition holds; the primary-axis status field is single-valued, so buckets 1, 2, 3 and 5 are already status-disjoint and precedence mainly resolves freshness-driven overlap
BUCKET_PRECEDENCE.residual_rule: an eligible case matching none of buckets 1 to 4 is projected to bucket 5 (NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES) with an explicit reason code; it must never be dropped and never be counted twice

PRODUCT_AXIS_PROJECTION.PRIMARY_ROOT_CAUSE_FILTER_SOURCE: Amendment 002 (WS-09 = HISTORY, WS-10 = RETRIEVAL, WS-11 = GENERATION)

CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES.condition: PRODUCT_STATUS = CURRENT_CONFIRMED_PRODUCT_DEFECT AND PRIMARY_ROOT_CAUSE_FILTER present in PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES AND ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = CURRENT
forbidden_sources: historical root-cause family presence without PRODUCT_STATUS = CURRENT_CONFIRMED_PRODUCT_DEFECT
an aggregate quality-gate gap promoted to a case-level confirmed defect
CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES.note: a current confirmed Product case carrying more than one Product family may enter more than one Product workstream through its own PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES; that is not a double count inside a single workstream

RESOLVED_CASES.condition: PRODUCT_STATUS = RESOLVED_OR_CLOSED AND the case is traceably associated with this Product workstream family
RESOLVED_CASES.family_association: PRIMARY_ROOT_CAUSE_FILTER present in PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES, or the case is traceably associated through its governing later remediation record for this family

condition_any_of: PRODUCT_STATUS = NOT_ESTABLISHED AND PRODUCT_CONFIDENCE = HISTORICAL_ONLY AND PRIMARY_ROOT_CAUSE_FILTER present in PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES
ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS in {PARTIALLY_CURRENT, HISTORICAL_STALE} with family relevance present (mechanically stale attribution)
HISTORICAL_OR_STALE_CASES.meaning: historically relevant for this workstream but not current-confirmed
HISTORICAL_OR_STALE_CASES.meaning_forbidden: the bucket name must never be read as ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = HISTORICAL_STALE

CURRENT_NEGATIVE_CASES.condition: NEVER for Product workstreams under the current enum vocabulary
CURRENT_NEGATIVE_CASES.reason: the Product axis enum has no explicit NO_CURRENT_PRODUCT_DEFECT_OBSERVED state; such a state must not be synthesized
CURRENT_NEGATIVE_CASES.forbidden: deriving a current negative Product state from PRODUCT_CONFIDENCE = HISTORICAL_ONLY, from an absent family, or from an absent product defect

NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES.condition: the case is inside this Product workstream's review domain but its current Product state for this workstream is not established AND it does not satisfy HISTORICAL_OR_STALE_CASES
NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES.explicit_exclusion: HISTORICAL_ONLY family evidence must not be placed here when it already qualifies for HISTORICAL_OR_STALE_CASES

CURRENT_NEGATIVE_CASES.semantics: explicit current negative evidence: a governed observation that no current measurement defect exists for this case

condition_any_of: mechanically traceable measurement evidence exists only historically (MEASUREMENT_STATUS = NOT_ESTABLISHED AND MEASUREMENT_CONFIDENCE = HISTORICAL_ONLY with a traceable historical measurement-family attribution)

NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES.condition: MEASUREMENT_STATUS = NOT_ESTABLISHED and the case is not moved to HISTORICAL_OR_STALE_CASES by evidence-backed historical-only measurement evidence

forbidden_sources: the aggregate citation coverage gap (citation_coverage = 0.4657) used directly as a case-level confirmed citation defect
Product or Measurement state used to populate current-confirmed Citation cases

CURRENT_NEGATIVE_CASES.forbidden_inference: this state must not be inferred merely because invalid_citation_count = 0 (or citation_scope_violation = 0) unless case-level governed evidence supports it

condition_any_of: citation-specific case evidence exists only historically with a traceable historical citation-family attribution (CITATION_STATUS = NOT_ESTABLISHED AND CITATION_CONFIDENCE = HISTORICAL_ONLY)

NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES.condition: CITATION_STATUS = NOT_ESTABLISHED and citation-specific historical evidence does not place the case in HISTORICAL_OR_STALE_CASES

CITATION_AXIS_PROJECTION.aggregate_metric_rule: citation_coverage = 0.4657 is a quality-gate signal only; it does not alter any case bucket directly

BUCKET_EVIDENCE_METADATA.traceability: every projected entry must carry its governing source reference under the frozen hierarchy S1 > S2 > S3 > S4; an entry without a traceable source is not admissible

HISTORICAL_ONLY_VS_MECHANICALLY_STALE.HISTORICAL_ONLY_EVIDENCE: the case's primary axis is NOT_ESTABLISHED and only a historical family / label attribution exists; reason code HISTORICAL_ONLY_FAMILY; the evidence is not stale, it was simply never refreshed
HISTORICAL_ONLY_VS_MECHANICALLY_STALE.MECHANICALLY_STALE_ATTRIBUTION: the primary axis is STALE_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRES_REFRESH, or ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS in {PARTIALLY_CURRENT, HISTORICAL_STALE} with RELEVANT_LATER_CHANGE = YES and traceable relevance evidence; reason code MECHANICALLY_STALE
HISTORICAL_ONLY_VS_MECHANICALLY_STALE.distinguishability_source: the reason codes and the primary-axis status / confidence fields carried in the projected entry metadata
HISTORICAL_ONLY_VS_MECHANICALLY_STALE.freshness_independence: bucket membership never rewrites ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS and never asserts ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = HISTORICAL_STALE for a historical-only case

CROSS_WORKSTREAM_COUNTING.condition: only when independently governed axes / family sets support that appearance
CROSS_WORKSTREAM_COUNTING.governed_example: md-004 may appear as a WS-11 CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASE through the Product GENERATION family and independently as a WS-12 CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASE through the Measurement axis; Product Generation and Measurement are separate governed axes
CROSS_WORKSTREAM_COUNTING.note: cross-workstream appearance is not duplicate counting; two buckets inside one workstream is a hard error

R3_CONSISTENCY_GATES.SUM_RULE: for every workstream: CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES + HISTORICAL_OR_STALE_CASES + RESOLVED_CASES + CURRENT_NEGATIVE_CASES + NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES = that workstream's mechanically eligible review-domain case count (counted after domain eligibility filtering)
R3_CONSISTENCY_GATES.unassigned_eligible_case_handling: R3 must FAIL rather than silently drop an eligible case matching no bucket

workstream_bucket_projection.NON_AUTHORITATIVE_PRECEDENCE_NOTE: the projection precedence in this amendment is a de-duplication device only; it never overrides a contradictory primary-axis status and it never creates authorization, readiness or priority content
